title: Shivaa Jewels — 56s FEATURE TRAILER (Hindi, one female presenter)
character_lock:
SAME WOMAN IN ALL SEVEN CLIPS — do not change her face, hair, jewellery or clothes:
Shivaa Jewels brand presenter and model. Indian, 27, North-Indian Rajasthani features, 5'8", luminous fair-wheatish skin, oval face, high cheekbones, deep almond dark-brown eyes, thick natural brows, soft nude-rose lips, a small gold nose pin, long straight black hair with a soft centre parting tucked behind one ear, one delicate 22K chain, small gold jhumkas.
WARDROBE LOCKED: deep-maroon silk saree with a thin gold zari border, black silk blouse, one gold kada on the right wrist.
Editorially beautiful but a REAL human — visible skin texture and pores, no plastic AI face, no celebrity lookalike, no beauty-ad over-retouch, no changing age between clips.
POISE: film-trailer narrator — calm authority, a small knowing smile, she owns the house she walks through. She is inside the film, never a news anchor at a desk.
VOICE: invent ONE original female Hindi voice — warm low alto, cinematic trailer gravitas, clean Khadi Boli Hindi, unhurried but urgent. Do not imitate any real person or any uploaded voice. No English narration, no jingle, no shopping-channel pitch, no whisper-ASMR.
LIP-SYNC: her mouth must match the exact Hindi line written in this clip. No extra words, no ad-libs, no humming, no repeated lines.
prefix:
Photoreal CINEMATIC BRAND TRAILER, 16:9, EXACTLY 8.00 seconds, 24fps, 1920x1080, ARRI Alexa 35, 35mm and 50mm, shallow depth of field, anamorphic flares, fine film grain, warm 3200K tungsten with gold bounce, black marble, brass and dark walnut luxury jewellery maison, India 2026.
This is ONE CONTINUOUS 56-second film cut into 7 shots — same woman, same maison, same lighting, same colour grade, same music. Begin EXACTLY on the previous clip's last frame and keep her walking the same journey through the house.
ON-SCREEN TEXT: ONLY the single headline card described in this clip — gold type on black/negative space, Devanagari large with small English under it, in for 1.5s, dissolve out. NO subtitles, NO karaoke captions, NO lower thirds, NO watermark, NO city names, NO readable rupee figures, NO readable gold-rate digits, NO logos except SHIVAA JEWELS where specified.
GENERATE: video + her Hindi speech + instrumental score + scene sound. The score is ONE continuous cue across all 7 clips — santoor, cello, low strings and a soft dhol pulse that keeps rising; instrumental only, no lyrics, no sung words, no choir words; always UNDER her voice.

scenes.line_hi: आज का सोना, आज के भाव पर। शिवा ज्वेल्स — हर सेकंड लाइव रेट, स्क्रीन पर।
scenes.line_roman: Aaj ka sona, aaj ke bhaav par. Shivaa Jewels — har second live rate, screen par.
scenes.visual: COLD OPEN. Night. Tall bronze doors of a dark jewellery maison split open and gold light blows out. Our presenter walks straight at camera out of that light in the maroon saree, unhurried, a Steadicam retreating ahead of her at chest height — the film starts on HER. She walks the centre aisle between lit vitrines of 22K bridal gold. She turns her head to a full-height LIVE RATE wall of warm amber tickers on the right — the digits are beautiful but DEFOCUSED and unreadable, ticking, alive. She lifts one hand towards the moving numbers without stopping. Headline card burns in on the black negative space to her left, then dissolves.
scenes.last_frame: Her half-turned to camera at the glowing rate wall, gold ticker bokeh behind her right shoulder, lips closing on the last word.
scenes.score: Single santoor note in silence, then cello enters and a slow dhol heartbeat starts. Sparse, huge room tone.
scenes.scene_sound: Bronze door, heel on marble, low ticker hum, distant chandelier shimmer. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.line_hi: हर पीस हॉलमार्क बाइस कैरेट। दाम का पूरा हिसाब — मेटल, मेकिंग, जीएसटी, सब साफ़।
scenes.line_roman: Har piece hallmark baais carat. Daam ka poora hisaab — metal, making, GST, sab saaf.
scenes.visual: Continue from her at the rate wall. She steps one pace to a black glass counter where a bridal haar lies on velvet. TRAILER MACRO INSERT, 1.2s: a BIS hallmark punch stamping 22K into warm gold, sparks of dust, the tiny six-character HUID mark blooming into focus — real punched metal, not graphics. Back to her: she turns the piece over with two fingers and a clean gold-line hologram rises off the counter and SPLITS into three calm floating bars — metal, making, GST — pure light, elegant, NO readable numbers anywhere. Her eyes to camera on the last two words. Headline card over the black counter.
scenes.last_frame: Her fingertips on the haar, the three glowing breakdown bars fading, her eyes on camera.
scenes.score: One bright metallic 'ting' locked to the hallmark punch, cello holds, dhol pulse continues.
scenes.scene_sound: Punch on metal, velvet, glass, a soft UI chime for the breakdown. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.headline_en: TAP TO LOCK YOUR RATE · NEW CATALOGUE
scenes.line_hi: भाव ऊपर जाए तो भी आपका दाम वही — एक टैप में रेट लॉक। और हज़ारों नए डिज़ाइन।
scenes.line_roman: Bhaav ooper jaaye to bhi aapka daam wahi — ek tap mein rate lock. Aur hazaaron naye design.
scenes.visual: She walks on; camera arcs with her. She presses one fingertip to the moving rate glass — the ticker FREEZES under her finger and a gold ripple with a small forged padlock icon spreads across the wall while the rest of the numbers keep running behind it (still unreadable). She smiles once, small. She keeps walking and the wall beside her becomes a long dark design wall: rings, kundan sets, bangles, mangalsutras flying past as lit product stills in gold frames, endless, no prices on them. Her hand trails the wall. Headline card rides the design wall.
scenes.last_frame: Her mid-stride against the flowing design wall, gold lock glow still on her fingertips.
scenes.score: Dhol doubles, santoor arpeggio climbs, first real lift of the theme.
scenes.scene_sound: Glass tap, a deep lock 'thunk', whoosh of the passing design wall. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.line_hi: स्वर्ण निधि — ग्यारह जमा, एक हमारा। गोल्ड वैल्यू पर सौ प्रतिशत बायबैक, डिजिटल सर्टिफिकेट के साथ।
scenes.line_roman: Swarna Nidhi — gyaarah jama, ek hamaara. Gold value par sau pratishat buyback, digital certificate ke saath.
scenes.visual: She arrives at a warm walnut consultation table where a mother and her grown daughter sit (faces real, calm, never mugging). Insert 1s: a brass-cornered Swarna Nidhi passbook opening, eleven small gold coins set in a row in velvet and a TWELFTH coin placed by the presenter's own hand. Insert 0.8s: an old family bangle laid on a certified scale, display defocused, and a clean gold coin sliding back across the table. Insert 0.8s: a phone screen held by the daughter showing a gold-sealed digital certificate card, text unreadable. Presenter stands behind them, hand on the chair, speaking the last clause to camera. Headline card on the dark wood.
scenes.last_frame: The twelfth coin settling in the passbook velvet, her hand withdrawing, her face soft-focus behind.
scenes.score: Theme turns warm and major, strings widen, dhol softens under the family beat.
scenes.scene_sound: Passbook page, coin on velvet, scale beep, one phone tap. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.beat: B2B · BULLION DESK · DEAD STOCK · KARIGAR
scenes.headline_en: BULLION · PARTNER PORTAL · WE BUY YOUR DEAD STOCK
scenes.line_hi: व्यापारियों के लिए — बुलियन डेस्क, बी-टू-बी पोर्टल, कारीगर, और आपका डेड स्टॉक भी हम खरीदेंगे।
scenes.line_roman: Vyapaariyon ke liye — bullion desk, B2B portal, kaarigar, aur aapka dead stock bhi hum kharidenge.
scenes.visual: Hard energy shift, same house. She pushes through a brass door into the trade side. A) BULLION DESK: stacked 24K biscuits under a spot, a partner jeweller signing, a dark board of defocused amber rates. B) A large partner-portal screen where a grams ledger draws itself in clean gold lines, no readable figures. C) KARIGAR bench, a 70-year-old master with white beard and gold dust on his fingers, torch flaring on kundan — she puts a respectful hand on his shoulder as she passes. D) A visiting jeweller sets down a dusty tray of unsold old stock; she receives it with respect, not pity, and nods once. Faster cutting, still expensive. Headline card over the bullion stack.
scenes.last_frame: Her handshake with the visiting jeweller over the now-empty clean tray, karigar's torch glowing behind.
scenes.score: Percussion turns industrial and confident, brass note enters, biggest groove so far.
scenes.scene_sound: Brass door, biscuits clinking, torch hiss, goldsmith tap, handshake. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.headline_en: CUSTOM DESIGN · RING SIZER · VIDEO CONSULT · LIFETIME CARE
scenes.line_hi: अपनी डिज़ाइन बनवाइए। रिंग साइज़, वीडियो कॉल पर लाइव चेक, गिफ्ट कार्ड और लाइफटाइम केयर।
scenes.line_roman: Apni design banwaaiye. Ring size, video call par live check, gift card aur lifetime care.
scenes.visual: She walks into the bespoke studio — soft lamp, tracing paper, a pencil sketch of a peacock band on a glass table. The sketch LIFTS off the paper as a slow gold wireframe and resolves into the real finished ring in a velvet tray in front of her (in-camera magic, not cartoon VFX). Insert 0.7s: a brass ring-sizer fan opening across a woman's finger. Insert 1s: a tablet on a stand on a live video call — a customer's face small and warm, the presenter tilting a necklace to the lens before dispatch. Insert 0.7s: a slim gold gift card, and a cloth polishing an old Shivaa ring back to new. She turns to camera on the last two words. Headline card on the studio wall.
scenes.last_frame: The finished bespoke ring in velvet, her face behind it in soft focus, lamp bloom.
scenes.score: Theme goes intimate — solo santoor and a single cello line, space around her voice.
scenes.scene_sound: Pencil, paper, ring sizer click, tablet call chime, soft polishing cloth. Only her voice as speech.

scenes.line_hi: पसंद आया? एक टैप — सेम डे, इंश्योर्ड डिलीवरी। शिवा ज्वेल्स। शिवा डॉट इन।
scenes.line_roman: Pasand aaya? Ek tap — same day, insured delivery. Shivaa Jewels. shivaa dot in.
scenes.visual: She taps a dark phone once — no readable app UI, only a gold pulse. LIVE: a maroon Shivaa box is sealed with a gold ribbon and an insurance hologram sticker, rides a night car, and she personally places it into a customer's hands at a lit home doorway. She walks back through the bronze doors of the maison, turns once to camera under the brass lettering, and the camera cranes up and off her. CUT TO BLACK at 6.5s. Then the end card forms in molten gold on black, in camera: SHIVAA JEWELS (spelling S-H-I-V-A-A, double A, elegant high-contrast serif, wide tracking) with shivaa.in small and gold beneath it. Hold clean to exactly 8.00s.
scenes.last_frame: SHIVAA JEWELS wordmark and shivaa.in in gold on black, still, breathing light.
scenes.score: Full theme resolves on a warm major chord at the doorway, then the logo hit, then let it decay into near-silence for the final 1.0s.
scenes.scene_sound: One tap, ribbon, car at night, box on wood, door, then hush. She speaks only inside the first 6.5s; the last 1.5s is end card and music only.
